description: This file is a Perl module that defines functions and variables for parsing and managing package metadata and target metadata within a build or package management system.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a filehandle until a line matching @@ is found, concatenating lines with optional prefix.
methods.parse_package_metadata_usergroup: Parses user or group specifications in package metadata, validating IDs and names, and updating the corresponding hashes.
methods.confstr: Sanitizes a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.
methods.parse_target_metadata: Parses a target metadata file to extract build target details, profiles, dependencies, and associated configurations.
methods.parse_package_metadata: Parses a package metadata file, extracting package and source information, dependencies, categories, and related attributes.
methods.parse_package_manifest_metadata: Parses a package manifest file, extracting package-specific information such as version, dependencies, and source details.
methods.clear_packages: Resets all package-related global hashes to be empty.

methods: calls_duplicates_note: Method calls are internal and refer to other functions within the same module; no external method calls are present.
